units:
Create a production game sprite atlas, transparent RGBA background, square 1536x1536 or highest square resolution. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, TWELVE equal square cells, NO lines/grid/text/labels. Each object isolated entirely within its own cell with 15% clear transparent margin, ground contact centered in cell, consistent scale per category. Original military assets for Statefall inspired by the ORIGINAL 1996 Command & Conquer Red Alert overhead camera, modern detailed raster sprite quality. High orthographic overhead camera, visible roofs and short south-facing walls, building axes parallel to screen, NOT diamond isometric. Crisp readable grey concrete, weathered olive metal, restrained blue faction panels; detailed vents, doors, antennas. Sun upper-left, short soft ground contact shadow down-right. No terrain backgrounds, no scenic composition, no rounded cartoon aesthetic.
Exact cell order left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: 1 compact military-industrial FACTORY with two roof vents and a dark wide south vehicle bay; 2 RADAR station with one large tilted parabolic dish above a rectangular concrete equipment building; 3 SAM missile site with three tilted launcher tubes on a compact paved square platform; 4 COASTAL BATTERY single large naval cannon on a low concrete bunker pointing east.
Row 2: 1 PORT building with compact shore warehouse and short narrow pier extending to the right (no water); 2 CITY civic block with three small connected substantial concrete buildings, tallest center, blue roof details, no skyscraper; 3 ENGINEERING COMMAND workshop with garage opening and yellow overhead repair crane; 4 AIRFIELD small hangar with paved apron, blue details, NO aircraft, NO huge runway.
Row 3: 1 DESTROYER ship fully top-down pointing RIGHT/east, long detailed grey hull, gun turrets, bridge, radar and short mast, no water or wake, proportions 3:1 length to beam; 2 FIGHTER jet fully top-down pointing RIGHT/east, metallic slate grey swept wings and restrained blue insignia, no shadow; 3 REPAIR TRUCK fully top-down pointing RIGHT/east, olive-blue military utility truck with equipment bed and yellow maintenance crane, no terrain; 4 one natural small PINE TREE cluster of three evergreen trees with subtle ground shadow, no rocks or terrain.
All 12 objects fully visible with transparent separation. These are actual game assets, not an infographic, not a concept sheet with titles. Strong physical depth for buildings, fine but legible details, single coherent military art direction.
terrain: Game terrain texture atlas for a modern original-1996-Red-Alert-inspired overhead RTS. Square image, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square material textures filling each quadrant edge to edge. No dividers, no labels, no text, no objects, no perspective. Top left: natural muted olive temperate short grass with subtle earth speckles, restrained tonal range. Top right: packed dry grey-brown dirt and tiny gravel with subtle wheel-worn mineral grain, no large marks. Bottom left: deep slate-blue sea water from directly above, restrained small ripple texture, no whitecaps, no shoreline. Bottom right: faded concrete apron with tiny cracks and stains, no markings, no slabs with prominent borders. Fine photographic material detail suitable for small repeating patches, coherent soft noon light, flat evenly illuminated surfaces, low contrast to keep units readable. Not cartoon, not painted illustration.
